points.description: States that measuring voltage between two terminals indicates whether the terminals are in different electrical states (e.g. different potentials/charge levels). Equivalent wording such as 'a voltage reading shows a difference in electrical state between the two terminals' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that a voltage reading between two terminals indicates whether they have different electrical states. No mark if the answer only describes voltage as a generic quantity without linking it to the terminals' states, or says the reverse relationship.
